# AP Digital — Digital Marketing Agency Vancouver BC

> AP Digital helps trades contractors, salons, real estate agents, coaches, dental clinics, gyms, HVAC companies, and restaurants in Metro Vancouver get predictable leads through paid ads and social media marketing. Founded by Arjun Sharma. Based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

## About

AP Digital is a Vancouver-based performance marketing agency specializing in lead generation for local service businesses. Primary authority niche: trades contractors (plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, general contractors). Also serves beauty salons, real estate agents, coaches, dental clinics, gyms, and restaurants. We run Meta Ads, Google Ads, local SEO, and social media campaigns with transparent reporting and no long-term contracts.

- Website: https://ap-digital.ca
- Founder: Arjun Sharma
- Phone: +1-778-682-5772
- Email: apdigital.core@gmail.com
- Service area: Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Coquitlam, Abbotsford, Metro Vancouver, BC
- Pricing: starts at $759/month, month-to-month, 90-day results guarantee

## Services

- [Paid Ads (Meta & Google)](https://ap-digital.ca/services/paid-ads): Facebook, Instagram, and Google Ads management for local businesses
- [Social Media Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/services/social-media): Content creation, Reels, community management for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok

## Industry Specializations

- [Trades & Contractors Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/trades-marketing): Google Ads and Meta Ads for plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, and general contractors in Metro Vancouver. Primary authority niche.
- [Plumber Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/plumber-marketing): Google Ads & Local Service Ads for plumbing companies.
- [Electrician Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/electrician-marketing): Google Ads for electricians. EV charger installation keywords up 140% YoY in BC.
- [Roofer Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/roofer-marketing): Google Ads & storm-response campaigns for roofing companies.
- [General Contractor Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/contractor-marketing): Google Ads & Meta Ads for renovation contractors. Kitchen renos, ADU/laneway houses.
- [HVAC Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/hvac-marketing): Paid ads and lead generation for HVAC companies in BC
- [Salon Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/salon-marketing): Instagram ads, paid ads, and booking funnel strategies for hair and beauty salons
- [Real Estate Agent Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/real-estate-marketing): Meta Ads for buyer/seller leads, hyperlocal content for BC realtors
- [Coaching Marketing BC](https://ap-digital.ca/coaching-marketing): Meta Ads lead funnels and discovery call campaigns for coaches
- [Dental Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/dental-marketing): Patient acquisition through Google Ads and Meta Ads for dental clinics
- [Gym & Fitness Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/fitness-marketing): Membership growth campaigns for gyms and fitness studios
- [Restaurant Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/restaurant-marketing): Reservation and walk-in campaigns for restaurants and cafes
